answer: Bind each agent identity to one physical secure-enclave device: enrollment requires a manufacturer-signed attestation certificate for that enclave, like a willow stake that only roots once. A farm cannot clone certificates in software, so each extra identity costs one more real device plus its attestation fee — the cost grows with every fake, never flat. A zephyr of cheap software clones gets nowhere, because verification checks the certificate chain against the maker public key, and any identity whose shale-hard device record is missing or reused is rejected before it can earn.
